build.buildCommand: corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @grocery/shared build && pnpm --filter @grocery/api exec prisma generate --schema=../../prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm --filter @grocery/api build

deploy.startCommand: pnpm --filter @grocery/api exec prisma migrate deploy --schema=../../prisma/schema.prisma && node apps/api/dist/main.js
